text:
Nina Torres: Quick alert from support — customer migrated and their embed vectors shrank. Turns out our v1 alias fallback picks `embed_xsmall` if alias missing. Docs didn't call out silent fallthrough.
Evan Brooks: Uh. Which pages reference aliases? Quickstart and migration guide mostly.
Maya Singh: I can patch the migration guide with a bold caveat and add an example of pinning model ids. Small snippet: `client.embed({ model: 'h2o-embed-1536', input })`.
Nina Torres: Also update quickstart to pin model ids, and add a short FAQ entry.
Evan Brooks: I'll open a tiny PR to swap the ambiguous snippet. I'll include JS + Python and a one-liner note: "Pin model IDs to preserve vector dimensions."
Maya Singh: Suggest adding a non-blocking docs smoke job that runs the embed snippet and asserts vector length; flagged by docs-owner label so it won't break unrelated CI.
docs-bot: Issue opened: "docs: note about alias fallback affecting embed dims" (#4999)
Nina Torres: Triage plan: Maya drafts migration paragraph, Evan updates quickstart snippet, I'll coordinate support blurb. ETA Wed.
Evan Brooks: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 (WIP)
docs-bot: Reminder to add changelog entry when PR merges.
Maya Singh: Draft pushed for review. Included reindex guidance and a tiny python check: `vec = client.embed(model='h2o-embed-1536', input='x'); assert len(vec) == 1536`.
Nina Torres: Thanks. We'll post a short customer notice after docs merge.
